claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Primidone is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM; it is a low-potency antiepileptic prodrug whose only plausible antiproliferative effect would be weak, non-selective metabolic or physicochemical interference rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
